title: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), multi-factor authentication (MFA) is not enforced on the PEM… (CVE-2026-132661)
description: Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM) versions prior to 10.6.1 do not enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) on the PEM web application's own routes. This allows an attacker who knows a user's password, even if that user has enrolled a second factor, to bypass the second factor and access PEM pages and APIs with that user's permissions. Starting from PEM 10.6.1, MFA enforcement is applied to all authenticated PEM routes.
